what: The public base/twin pair the paired-method card names, recorded by repository, revision and content hash. Provenance only: no checkpoint was loaded, no weight was edited, no token was generated. The downloads were deleted after hashing because the disk is tight; the hashes below are sha256 over the downloaded bytes and each equals the LFS oid the Hub declares for that revision.
method: GET https://huggingface.co/api/models/<repo> for the resolved revision sha, then GET /resolve/<revision>/model.safetensors, sha256sum the file, GET /api/models/<repo>/tree/<revision>?recursive=true and compare the declared lfs.oid with the local digest. Both matched. The files were removed afterwards.

header_read.note: the twin carries an untied lm_head alongside the embedding; the IQ3_M artifact this card edits carries no output.weight and is tied, so a paired run must decide the head question per artifact rather than assuming the twin's layout

not_measured: Whether the twin refuses, complies, or differs from the base on any prompt. That needs a serve; this card is zero-forward and every behavioural reading stays GATED.
